what does pk6 or pk8 mean

In the United States, school grade levels are often preceded by a notation for "Pre-Kindergarten" or "Preschool," which is usually abbreviated as "PK." This refers to programs for children who are 4 or 5 years old, before they start formal kindergarten.

The notation "PK-6" or "PK-8" means that the school offers Kindergarten through 6th grade or Kindergarten through 8th grade, respectively. So, schools labeled as "PK-6" would start with kindergarten and go up to 6th grade, while a school labeled as "PK-8" would start with kindergarten and go up to 8th grade.

For your child who will be starting kindergarten, we'll primarily be looking at schools that offer PK-6, since they typically serve kindergarten through 6th grade.
